HB_GS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.description: Full path to Google service account JSON key file (e.g., D:\Keys\service-account.json)

HB_GS_SPREADSHEET_ID.description: Google Sheets spreadsheet ID from URL (e.g., 1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms)

HB_GS_SHEET_NAME.description: Name of the sheet/tab to update (e.g., 'Day 1', 'Nov 17', leave empty for first sheet)

HB_GS_HEADER_ROW.description: Row number where column headers are located (default: 6)
